description: A sample and hold that doubles as a voltage source set by hand, with the value shown on a display

params.text: Takes one off the held value, rounding a fractional value downwards to a whole number
Adds one to the held value, rounding a fractional value upwards to a whole number
Captures the voltage at the input and holds it; the lamp is lit while a value is being held

inputs.text: The voltage that is followed and held; while nothing has been held the module passes this voltage straight through
A rise here captures the voltage at the input and holds it

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
